title: Protocol for Sampling and Transport of Nose and Throat Samples
author: Dina Stensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2j5gcq6

steps.title: Collect Nasal Samples
steps.instruction: Collect two samples from the nasal cavity using rayon-tipped swabs.

substeps.instruction: Moisten the rayon-tipped swab in 2-3 drops of sterile NaCl 0.9 mg/ml.
Carefully insert the swab approximately 1-2 cm into the nasal cavity and rotate with delicate pressure 3 times in both nasal cavities (use the same swab for both anterior nares).
Place both swabs in the Coban transport medium.
Label the transport medium with the test number and 'nasal swab 1' (for bacterial analysis) and 'nasal swab 2' (for microbiome analysis).

steps.title: Collect Throat Samples
steps.instruction: Collect two samples from the throat using rayon-tipped swabs.

substeps.instruction: Moisten the rayon-tipped swab in 2-3 drops of sterile NaCl 0.9 mg/ml.
Ask the participant to open their mouth, press the tongue spatula against the tongue, and ask the participant to say 'aaa' to improve the view of the tonsil region.

Insert the swab into the oral cavity and swab both palatine tonsil regions with moderate pressure (if the participant had a tonsillectomy/tonsillotomy, swab the area of the removed tonsils); use the same swab on both tonsils.
Place both swabs in the Coban transport medium.
Label the transport medium with the test number and 'throat swab 1' (for bacterial analysis) and 'throat swab 2' (for microbiome analysis).

steps.title: Post-Procedure Hygiene
steps.instruction: Clean hands immediately following the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Wash hands with soap and water or use hand disinfection.
Place swabs in a suitable rack.
If not picked up immediately, place samples in the refrigerator awaiting pickup.
